description: QR Core is the free shared foundation. It is never sold as a module. Module contracts may only depend on these components, never on another commercial module.

components.summary: Accounts, Argon2id passwords, Google sign-in, sessions, CSRF, password recovery.
Tenant root, slug rules, branding (accent color, logo), Google Maps links.
establishment_members with owner and manager roles.
MemberRole to Permission mapping enforced by application::entitlements::authorize.
TenantContext extraction and establishment-scoped queries.
Administrative and security suspension (establishment_operational_states).
pt-BR, en and es catalogs with zero-reload switching.
Categories, products, prices in centavos, availability and visibility are implemented. Variations, add-on groups and add-on options are planned for Commerce Core.
Magic-byte validation, EXIF stripping, content-addressed variants.
Versioned catalog, quotes, contracts and contract snapshots (Commercial Engine).
Capability resolution from contracts and explicit grants (Entitlement Engine).
Asaas and Stripe hosted recurring card checkout, Banco Inter Pix/boleto charge per cycle; authenticated idempotent webhooks normalized into GatewayEvent; coverage per confirmed payment (ADR-011).
Transactional outbox append is implemented; the dispatcher ships with Commerce Core.
Publication log, outbox events for commercial and operational actions. A general admin audit log is planned.
Weekly hours, exceptions and holiday overrides per establishment.
Service modes, minimum order, fees and checkout settings.
Establishment-scoped consumer records with LGPD export and erasure.
Consumer delivery addresses scoped to one establishment.
Single Order aggregate shared by every sales channel (Commerce Core).
Consumer-to-establishment payments, separate from SaaS billing.
Email, web push and messaging delivery with per-establishment templates.
Per-establishment counters for storage, OCR, messages and external costs.
Atomic static snapshot publication shared by QR Menu and, later, the QR Delivery storefront.

implemented: Rate limits per IP and per account (governor) on auth, uploads, OCR and billing
Upload caps: 2 MiB logos, 5 MiB product photos (6 MiB multipart body), 16 MiB OCR requests, 64 KiB webhooks
OCR concurrency Semaphore(1) with subprocess timeouts
Mandatory review before OCR results reach the draft
